decision.text: D3: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearance.py gains its own test_the_scratch_bus_goes_with_its_home, mapped to d66f2e18fc5c clause 3 (test_codemother.py has one, test_clearance.py has none). After _shutdown_ask_bus nothing the scratch HOME started still runs: the bus does not answer AND the ground loop it woke is gone. Measured 2026-11-13 by akiendell: a scratch bus under a clearance HOME woke its own ground loop, and _shutdown_ask_bus stops only the bus. Measured on akienyoga9i: a green clearance run left no stray; the stray came from a run that died at connect. HYPOTHESIS, unmeasured: the stray needs the failure path (a child that dies before the reply), so the tooth also drives one ask that fails at connect and asserts the same. A run settles it either way.
